U_0x0045EE: A humanoid mobile weapon of the Machinery Children. A Mass-Prod Huckebein Mk-II remade with <Machine Cell> for new form and higher specs. Mounts the <Geim System> and remote weapons; its <Machine Cell> frame self-repairs.
U_0x0047B4: A special anti-alien humanoid mobile weapon developed by the <Tesla Leicht Institute> for the Earth Sphere Defense Committee. Built around physical attack by sheer mass, its size and shape are meant to intimidate intelligent foes. Designed to fight powerful enemies beyond a <Personal Trooper>, it boasts exceptional output and attack power. Its huge blade, the "Type-0 Zankantou," can cleave battleship-class objects in two. High-thrust boosters and trim balancers on its back enable free-ranging sword combat, and its TGC joints cut load by controlling inertial mass via gravity control. After the <Inspector Incident>, a refit gave it a plasma reactor.
U_0x004CA5:
The Grungust is a special humanoid mobile weapon developed at the <Tesla Leicht Institute> from data on the Grungust Type-0 and the PTX-007-02 Gespenst Mk-II (Type S).
To perform in every domain, it transforms into a flight form (Winggust) and a heavy tank form (Gustlander). Its armor uses VG Alloy (Variable Geometric Alloys), an active metal that lets it transform while largely ignoring structural and shape constraints. It runs on a plasma reactor, and its TGC joints cut load by controlling inertial mass via gravity control. Built-in weapons like the Boost Knuckle and Final Beam make it excel at close combat, aided by a brainwave control unit and voice-input weapon selector. Among the demanding Grungust series it has the best overall balance, earning the nickname "Super Fighter."
The Grungust Kai is an upgraded Grungust, fitted with booster-equipped Roundel Wings and beam cannons for greater mobility and firepower. Even with the Wings it can still become the Winggust and Gustlander.
U_0x005393: The flight form of the Grungust Kai. The Roundel Wings extend its cruising range.
U_0x005424: The Grungust Kai's heavy tank form. Firepower is boosted.
U_0x0054BB: Third unit (SRG-03-3) of the newest Grungusts, from the <Tesla Leicht Institute> under the <SRX Project>, unfrozen after the <L5 Campaign>. Based on the Grungust (Type-1) and specialized for melee, it has the series' highest output and attack power. It splits into the G-Raptor fighter (upper body) and G-Bison tank (lower body), one pilot in each. After the <Inspector Incident>, it gained the <T-LINK System>, a <Tesla Drive>, and the Type-3 Shishioh Blade (<S.Unit>-size).
